rationale: Reproduction result. The fixed experiment behind the post-heal agreement witness was re-executed from its retained inputs in a clean copy with no change to the scenario, isolation, window or declaration, and the outcome repeats: receipt 6fc5c2c2f19c47a18d9613a11dd9863f (exit 0) again has comparison 0 violated at witness event index 27 - the isolated node and the majority-side leader hold different entries at the same log index eight seconds after healing, with both_sides_acknowledged true - and comparison 1 holding at evaluated event index 29, where the flag-off control's two sides agree at that index. Together with receipt a608e5f60ae4415981c1024522a24a0d the agreement violation is now witnessed in two independent executions of the same fixed experiment, so the limitation that it rested on a single probe no longer applies; the window dependence remains, since the two-second-window receipt 4e9eaa72cf594018b8414a8d8efb7cb3 is still a negative for entry loss and for applied-without-log divergence. The same repeat also reproduced the concurrent two-sided acknowledgement and the minority leadership, so no claim in this question changes and none grows beyond what the receipts show.

interpretations.rationale: Five completed comparisons with controls establish the defect and its consequences, and the newest of them has now reproduced. Configuration: receipt b15f4b6c55b44402ace926204de9b826, violated at witness event index 15 - the node restarted from a log whose latest configuration is index 14 with five servers came back at configuration index 1 with three servers - control holding at index 18. Election: abfdbd1823b342409ef4a815bade0407, violated at witness index 22 - the isolated node became leader with reachable_votes 2 against committed_quorum 3 - control holding at index 25. Acknowledgements: 568bebb18e574cafa18e96add68e89db, violated at witness index 27 (the isolated leader's Apply completed), and f0db8b71047e42df96d3e2f4f581835c, violated at witness index 27 (both sides acknowledged a client write concurrently), each with its control holding at index 29. Log agreement after healing: a608e5f60ae4415981c1024522a24a0d and its repeat 6fc5c2c2f19c47a18d9613a11dd9863f, both violated at witness event index 27 - eight seconds after healing the two nodes hold different entries at the same log index while both_sides_acknowledged is true and neither node applied an entry absent from its own log - controls holding at index 29. Source: restoreFromCommittedLogs (api.go:724-754) advances lastApplied to the persisted commit index before the startup scan at api.go:604-620, so AddVoter's later entry (api.go:994-1005) is never re-read and the node keeps the snapshot's three-server list; quorumSize() (raft.go:1087-1094) then returns two, electSelf (raft.go:1999-2060) asks only that list, and commitment accepts two matching indexes, so leadership and acknowledgements rest on a majority of an obsolete configuration while the two sides never reconcile across the index they each wrote.
counterevidence: The flag-off controls in every cited execution keep the committed configuration, cannot win on the isolated side, do not acknowledge there and agree after healing.

The two-second-window receipt remains a negative for entry loss and for applied-without-log divergence, so what is witnessed is two logs keeping different entries at one index rather than an entry disappearing.
Settled-schedule executions did not produce the minority leadership, explained by whether the isolated partner still heard the majority-side leader; no frequency or absence claim is made.
limitations: Every observation is bounded (three second majority-leader wait, five second election window, two second apply timeout, two or eight second heal settle), so no occurrence-rate or absence bound is established; what the repeat shows is that the eight-second outcome is reproducible on this schedule, not that it is universal.

The agreement comparison is emitted as a derived boolean computed from reading both logs at the isolated side's last index; the two entry payloads are not emitted, so their contents are not inspectable from the receipts.
The scenario restarts the former leader of a cluster grown by adding voters over in-memory stores; other roles, change types, chain orders and durable stores are not explored.
interpretations.joint_history: Receipts a608e5f60ae4415981c1024522a24a0d and 6fc5c2c2f19c47a18d9613a11dd9863f are two executions of the same fixed experiment with identical inputs, and they agree on every operand (disagreement at the conflict index true with both sides acknowledging, control agreeing); the second is a reproduction of the first, not a continuation of it. Receipts b15f4b6c55b44402ace926204de9b826, abfdbd1823b342409ef4a815bade0407, 568bebb18e574cafa18e96add68e89db and f0db8b71047e42df96d3e2f4f581835c are earlier complete executions of the same scenario whose declarations differed; all cited receipts report the same configuration values (flagged side at index 1 with three servers against expected 14 with five; controls at 14 with five).
